Attached: 1 image

My AI agent has its own sandboxed Linux computer. I ask from my phone, watch it work live, and it stops to ask before the risky step. One tap to approve.

Casama's apps and safety rules are open source (AGPL-3.0, Apache-2.0); the engine is closed and installs as signed container images, free for personal use on your own machine or server (any model, local included) or on Casama Cloud. https://github.com/casama-ai/casama

#OpenSource #SelfHosted #AIAgents
